# Halvard Systems Contingent Staffing Policy

Contingent staffing policy of Halvard Systems. Restricted to the people team. Synthetic evaluation material for a fictional company.

## Purpose and Scope

This policy governs how Halvard Systems engages contingent workers through staffing vendors. It is restricted to the people team.

## Background Screening Standard

A staffing vendor must complete background screening for every contingent worker before the assignment starts and must record the screening date.

## Contingent Worker Tenure Limit

A contingent worker may not hold the same assignment for more than eighteen (18) months without a people team exception.

## Rate Card Approval

Staffing rate cards are approved annually, and an uplift above five percent requires people team and finance approval.
